questions: What is a canon?
If something enters the canon, does the story stop changing?
What is a frame?
If the frame is removed, does the picture still mean the same thing?
What is an installation?
If the installation is taken apart, is it gone for good?
What is appropriation?
If the appropriation is returned, does the image become original again?
What is an archive?
If the archive is deleted, is the past gone?
What is an image?
If an image is copied perfectly, does the copy carry the same authority?
What does curation do?
If the curation changes, do the same things mean the same?
What is representation?
If representation increases, does everyone become visible?
What is a period?
When the period ends, does the next one begin with a clean break?
What is an icon?
If an icon is copied, does every copy have the same power?
What is the gaze?
If the gaze is returned, does the power become equal?
What is a performance?
If the performance is repeated, is it still the same performance?
What is spectacle?
When the spectacle ends, does everything return to normal?
What is style?
If the style is copied exactly, does it belong to the same time?
What is restoration?
If the restoration succeeds, is it new again?
